channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "SCP Proposal: The Red Girl (1st SCP)" - A new humanoid, Euclid-class SCP, which undergoes some dangerous changes

item.title: Re: Forum Criticism Team - Captain Post
item.content:encoded:
1) SCPs generally have some mystery to them; in that regard, I'm not sure if pointing out that there are nothing but mysteries surrounding an SCP works.

2) The SCP just has too many mysteries surrounding her; just some sort of direction (a Sarkic tattoo, a Marshall, Carter & Dark receipt, basically just one clue to her past) would be appreciated.

3) Otherwise, while I agree that the "rage and forget" is cliche, I like the idea of a reptilian humanoid hiding as a human; it takes the "social chameleon" in an interesting direction.

item.title: Re: Forum Criticism Team - Captain Post
item.content:encoded: Zyn, I'm grateful for your warning regarding said "rage state" approach, and I can understand it might not be as interesting anymore. That being said, I'm not sure if there's much of an alternative approach. I really like both forms of the Red Girl and I want to implement both of them in my idea. What if I, for example, change them into two separate entities? Would that change the concept from the status quo?

item.title: Forum Criticism Team - Captain Post
item.content:encoded:
JamaisJ, can you elaborate a bit here to better help the author?

There's a lot of really cool things going on here,

Can you be more specific about what you liked here, and why? As an aside, the majority of the community isn't too keen on the typical overused "rage state" powers approach (that sort of formulaic setup has often been seen in low-rated articles that wound up quickly deleted).

but you need to pick a direction of some sort. There's no real narrative, just a lot of questions; solidify something in that regard.

What direction are you talking about here? Ongoing narrative involving the Foundation? Background context? Test logs with implications? What would you as a reader need to see solidified in order to be more interested in reading a draft of this material?

item.title: Re: SCP Proposal: The Red Girl (1st SCP)
item.content:encoded:
So it's basically a were-dragon of unknown origin that is triggered by anger and forgets her actions?

There's a lot of really cool things going on here, but you need to pick a direction of some sort. There's no real narrative, just a lot of questions; solidify something in that regard.

item.title: SCP Proposal: The Red Girl (1st SCP)
item.content:encoded:
A new humanoid, Euclid-class SCP, which undergoes some dangerous changes when exposed to rage, and might have a connection towards the SCPs Cain and Abel.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: SCP-XXXX, AKA the Red Girl, is a humanoid anomaly which takes the appearance of a 15-16 year old girl with with long hair and irises in a unnatural shade of bright red. The Red Girl shows usually sweet, affective behavior, but will get triggered if she gets visually or audibly exposed to rage or hatred, or senses rage in a nearby person. SCP-XXXX will undergo a rapid transformation, in which she grows red scales on 60% of her body, will grow claws and fangs and the hair will turn into spikes. SCP-XXXX will then attempt to viciously attack the person that it sensed the anger from, often resulting in a chain reaction if multiple people are nearby, although it will never attack more than 8 people in a row. After the attack, SCP-XXXX will show shock and remorse over its own deeds, and slowly regain her human appearance. Attempts learn SCP-XXXX to control this states have proven ineffective, as the Red Girl seems to lose all memories of the incident within the next 8 hours.

Central Narrative: Although the origins of SCP-XXXX are unbeknownst even to her, Foundation researchers have found one potential clue: on the left shoulder blade, SCP-XXXX bears a tattoo of Sumerian origin, meaning 3 in the original language. This might be a link to SCP-073, who carries a similar mark on his body. Some researchers even started to reference to SCP-XXXX as 'the third sibling', although further research will be necessary before a link can be confirmed.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I want to expand the concepts of SCP-073 and SCP-076. Wouldn't it be interesting to see what would happen if it gets confirmed that Cain and Abel in the SCP universe have a younger sister, who possesses yet another set of anomalous abilities, alongside resemblance in personalities from both brothers?
[[/collapsible]]
As a courtesy to our readers on mobile devices, please collapse long posts. ~Zyn
